response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive full-stack development experience with a strong focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frameworks like React and Nest.js. His background in AI-agent infrastructure, developer tooling, and enterprise-scale systems aligns well with the role's requirements. His open-source contributions and leadership in technical workshops further highlight his expertise and collaborative mindset.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (8+ years) with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Nest.js, directly matching the primary stack.
Proven track record in AI-agent development and developer tooling, including contributions to Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks.
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in technical workshops, demonstrating deep expertise and community engagement.
concerns: Limited explicit mention of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) or containerization (Kubernetes) in recent roles, though Docker is listed as a skill.
Some roles involved niche languages (DLang) or legacy systems, which may not directly translate to the primary stack.
German language proficiency is basic, which could be a minor limitation in a Berlin-based team.
